component.name: Open Documents Viewer
component.summary: Fast, read-only viewer for Markdown, text, code and data files

description.p: Open Documents Viewer opens documents fast and only shows them: nothing is edited, nothing leaves your computer.

ul.li: Markdown rendered with native widgets, with a one-click switch to the source
Syntax highlighting for code and config files: JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, XML, .env and more
CSV and TSV as tables, even with millions of rows
Open a folder and browse it in a tree, open many files in tabs, split the window in two

description.p: No ads, no account, no tracking. Part of libre-apps.
First release: Markdown, text, code, config and CSV files; folder tree, tabs and split view.
